full_judgment: 1) That the instant case for transfer deserves consideration of the Hon'ble Court on the ground that in a case for offence under section 26(2) and section 27(1) of the Anti-Corruption Commission Ain, 2004 the burden of proof lies heavily upon the accused that information furnished in statement relating to acquisition of wealth and other matters cannot be considered false and baseless and that he does not possess any property resorting to any dishonest means or acquired by dishonest means-and the same is not in any way disproportionate to any known source of income; and as ordained in section 27(1), he is required to account for possession of properties to the satisfaction of the trial court. Thus, onus lies heavily on the defense to prove his innocence unlike other cases and the accused of necessity is required to discharge this onus to the satisfaction of the court by examining such number of defence witnesses as may be necessary in the facts and circumstances of the case.
